# Dave Root
[DaveRoot](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/cc/DaveRoot.png/revision/latest?cb=20211129141439)
**Dave Root** is a former Hot Wheels designer who interned at Mattel for three months in 2015, designing four castings for the Hot Wheels lineup while studying for the College of Creative Studies. He is currently a designer for Ford, a position he has held since 2016.
In addition to his work at Ford, Root also builds hot rods.
